_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kamu adolah Pamain {player_id} dalam Tic Tac Toe Tigo Pamain.
Simbol kamulah '{symbol}'.
Kamu bagiliran maletakkan simbol kamulah pado papan 5x5 untuak mambantuak garisan ampek.
Garis-garis dapek horizontal, vertical, atau diagonal.
Sampaikan gerakan kamulah manggunoan format '[4]' untuak maletakkan sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format pamindahan indak sah. Gunakannyo "[cell]" di mano sel adolah 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomor sel nan salah: {cell}. Harus antaro 0 dan {max_cell}.
